fields.System.Title: FDN-603 — Units of measure and conversions
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to define how many units are in a case and how many
cases on a pallet, so that quantities entered in one unit convert correctly to the base
unit.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product, then it has a base UoM in which all stock is stored internally.
  • - Given a case quantity, then it must be greater than zero.
  • - Given a quantity entered in cases, then it is converted to base units before any
  • balance is changed.
  • - Given a conversion, then it never produces a fractional base quantity.
  • - Given a receipt or pick, then the UoM used is recorded on the movement, not just the
  • converted number.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | uom, uom_conversion, product |
| Risks | Wrong case quantity multiplies across every transaction ([doc 03 §7.1](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
